name: @treaty/ssg
description: Static Site Generation for Treaty apps: prerender routes to static HTML at BUILD time. Treaty is a compiler, not a host — @treaty/ssg discovers prerenderable routes (static + parameterized) from an Angular Routes / @treaty/module-federation route config, compiles each route's component(s) to Ivy via @treaty/compiler, executes any top-of-file ``` macro / RSC render-time data through the Nova runtime (a RenderRuntime the Nova-backed run_macro impl satisfies), statically interprets the emitted Ivy template against that data, and emits a static, hydration-ready HTML document per route plus a route -> output-file manifest. prerenderAll(config) is the one-call entry point. SSG only EMITS static output; serving it is the dev/platform job. The Angular platform-server / @angular/platform-browser hydration pieces are referenced structurally as optional peers.
author: Jordan Hall
